_comment: Hand-adjudicated EODHD codes for names the automatic matcher could not resolve. Each code is verified against the EODHD LSE listed/delisted lists at resolve time; a code absent from both lists demotes the entry to the exception/remediation list. null = adjudicated unresolvable (e.g. dummy lines).
_Witan: Auto-match picked the 87IP note line; WTAN is the equity.
_Menzies: Auto-match picked the 68HN note line; MNZS is the equity.
_888: LSE code '888' (renamed evoke 2023; auto-match picked the US OTC line EIHDF).
_Pendragon: LSE code PDG (auto-match picked US OTC PDGNF).
_Phoenix: LSE code PHNX (auto-match picked US OTC PNXGF). Note: pre-2018 line PGH-era data may be partial.
_Sanne: LSE code SNN (auto-match picked US OTC SNNRF).
_Spirax: LSE code SPX; will resolve via FTSE 100 master anyway after reorder.
_TIFS: Kept: verify the TIFS.LSE payload; IPO September 2017.
